pairs.difference: A: the mailbox's blue paint has small scratch and scuff marks across the lower door panel and the front edge, plus several small round rivet heads along the seam. B: the bird feeder's planks have only quiet, broad grain lines, and the seeds are smooth simple ovals.
pairs.fix: Smooth, clean blue painted metal with no scratches or scuffs; drop the small rivets and keep one broad seam band.

pairs.difference: B: every bean in the tin bowl is equally glossy, with tiny bubbles in the sauce and a hard chrome shine on the bowl rim and spoon, so the whole object reads as one lacquered material. A: the glass plate, the fruit skins and the matte watermelon flesh each have a different level of shine.
pairs.fix: Beans with a soft satin sheen, a matte enamel bowl with one broad highlight, and no small bubbles in the sauce.

pairs.difference: B: the hat's felt has a faint, even, noise-like grain over the crown and brim, which reads as soft clay. A: the jacket's fabric has broad, clean folds, and the badges are smooth. The evidence is weak on both cards.
pairs.fix: Smooth matte felt with clean broad shading and no surface noise on the crown or brim.

pairs.difference: A: the clock face is crowded with a ring of tiny minute dots and thin tick marks, a glass glare streak and a bracket hanger with several parts, so it reaches the top of the detail range. B: the cap has flat matte faces, crisp corners and one simple cord.
pairs.fix: Fewer, bolder hour marks with no ring of minute dots, and a simple smooth rim without layered glass glare.

pairs.difference: A: the wagon canvas has dashed stitch seams and a cloth weave, small brass tacks run along its edge, and the side boards carry visible wood-grain lines. B: the coaster cars are smooth, broad plastic shapes with no surface marks.
pairs.fix: Smooth plain canvas with no stitching or tacks, and wooden boards with only faint, quiet grain.

pairs.difference: A: the floorboards have large decorative knots and grain, the guitar body is blurred and smeared like a painting, and its frets and tuning pegs are fussy small marks. Detail is far above the range of the real cards. B: the racket and ball are clean, with smooth plastic and a soft felt texture on the ball only.
pairs.fix: Plain warm floorboards with very faint grain and no knots; a crisp, smooth guitar body with a few simple frets.

pairs.difference: A: the spur straps have fine dashed stitching along both edges, and the metal is mirror chrome on every part, so the shiny share is far above the real range. B: the pillow is a soft matte fabric with broad puckers.
pairs.fix: Plain leather straps with no stitch lines; satin grey metal with one soft highlight instead of mirror chrome everywhere.

pairs.difference: B: the boot shafts carry dotted stitch embroidery in red, with dashed seam stitching around the vamp, which is small toy-like detail. A: the gloves are smooth leather with a few broad creases and one soft sheen.
pairs.fix: Smooth leather boots with a simple flat painted flame shape and no dotted or dashed stitching.

pairs.difference: B: the column's fluting is softly smeared, and a sharp, deep crack is cut across the stone surface. A: the golf iron has a few broad grooves, the ball has clean dimples, and the metal is smooth with a mild shine.
pairs.fix: Smooth, even stone fluting without a crack, with clean edges on each flute.

pairs.difference: B: the sneakers are covered in a fine dotted mesh texture, and the laces are glossy and tangled, so detail and gloss are both at the top of the range. A: the cactus has broad, smooth ribs, simple spines and a matte clay pot.
pairs.fix: Sneaker uppers in smooth, broad fabric panels with no dotted mesh; simple matte laces.

pairs.difference: B: the harmonica cover is mirror chrome with streaked reflections, and small rivet heads sit on the red end caps, so the shiny share is above the real range. A: the fan is matte, flat paper with plain wooden ribs.
pairs.fix: Satin brushed-grey metal cover with one broad soft highlight and plain red end caps without rivets.

pairs.difference: B: the pump body has a speckled, pitted cast-iron texture with rust flecks, small hex bolts sit around the base, and the stone slab is grainy and noisy. A: the coin viewer is smooth metal in broad, simple parts with clean shading.
pairs.fix: Smooth green painted metal with no rust specks or pitting, a simple base ring without bolts, and a plain smooth stone slab.

pattern: Generated cards add small surface detail that the real cards simplify away: dashed stitches on leather and canvas, rivets, bolts and tacks, dotted mesh, rust specks, and wood knots with grain. They also push metal to mirror chrome across the whole object. Real cards keep broad, smooth, mostly satin surfaces that shade cleanly and carry only one or two soft highlights.
